note: Read by tools/export_map_paths.py. Young's modulus of the body, in pascals, for records whose own metadata.materials.young_modulus_body is not set. Each entry is keyed by record id and holds "modulus_Pa", "source" (the file it is read from, pinned by repository, commit, path, sha256 of the file at that commit, the symbol read and its line, and the record's CAD folder, where a materials.json would override it) and "why" (why that value is the one the run used). The map uses a record's own modulus where it has one; an entry here for such a record is refused. tests/test_export_map_paths.py checks each pin against the repository when it is present. Not listed: the literature and measured records, none of which states a body modulus, and shadow_hand_finger and example_rigid_pneumatic_cylinder, which are rigid. Nothing here comes from, or goes into, data/records.

bellows1.why: The record's metadata.materials is empty and its CAD folder (gramian_map/cads/bellows/bellows1) holds no materials.json, on disk or anywhere in the repository's history, so the scene ran with its own default body modulus. The generator (make_bellows.py) writes materials.json only when given --bladder_E, and the record's generator command does not give it. The value is read from the scene at the repository's first commit (14 July 2026); the record was built earlier, in early July, before the repository's history starts, so this is the scene's default as first committed, not a copy taken at the run itself.
